note: The five TransactWriteItems tests that failed the 3.6.0 measurement's ground-truth run against eu-west-2, run as the 3.6.0 suite asserts them: five times against eu-west-2 from 21:56 UTC on 2026-10-08, then once against all 33 answering regions from 22:00 UTC, each run a separate process. eu-west-2, eu-north-1 and ap-northeast-2 gave the new answer to all five, every time. The other 30 regions gave the answer the tests assert. An old answer is recorded as the test asserts it, since a pass reports nothing more; a new answer is recorded from the error the test failed on. eu-south-2 and me-central-1 never reach the transacted half of the item-size test, because their UpdateItem stores the first write.
